map.summary: This batch maps the foundation layer of a hybrid RAG service: a FastAPI app entry point with health/readiness endpoints, typed settings, a SQLAlchemy async database base, document storage service, and a linear Alembic migration chain building identity, content, retrieval, evaluation/audit, and ingestion-job schema. Container, Makefile, and CI workflows build and verify the backend.
unknowns: No HTTP routes or user-facing actions exist beyond health endpoints in this batch; whether a UI or retrieval/search API exists is untraced (F0030).
Downstream readers/writers of documents.storage_key, content_hash, and index_version are not present in this batch (F0031).
The retrieval pipeline that populates query_traces fields (selected_path, rankings, timings, usage, fallback) is not in these sources (F0032).
Whether helper functions set_updated_at() and prevent_mutation() are truly provided by an earlier migration is inferred from invocation, not an in-file definition (F0048).
How constants and pipeline_version values for ingestion recipes are derived at runtime is only implied by check constraints (F0064).

diagrams.title: Architecture
diagrams.description: FastAPI app, config, database base, and migration chain form the backend foundation; multiple entry points and tooling invoke them.

diagrams.title: Health and readiness flow
diagrams.description: Readiness probes three dependencies concurrently and returns 503 when any check fails; liveness shares one handler.

diagrams.title: Document upload flow
diagrams.description: Upload hashes bytes, locks the collection row, dedupes on content hash, and writes storage off the event loop.

diagrams.title: Document delete flow
diagrams.description: Deletion uses two transactions: durable DELETING intent, then storage removal with DELETED status.

diagrams.title: Schema evolution
diagrams.description: Linear Alembic revisions build identity, content, retrieval, evaluation/audit, then incremental ingestion-job columns with triggers.

F0001.statement: backend/Dockerfile builds the image from python:3.12.14-slim-bookworm, copies pyproject.toml and src, installs the package with pip, and starts the API via CMD running uvicorn on hybrid_rag_search.main:app with app-dir /app/src on host 0.0.0.0 port 8000.

F0002.statement: backend/src/hybrid_rag_search/main.py defines create_app(), which instantiates FastAPI, reads settings via get_settings(), and includes the evaluation router before registering the /health, /health/live, and /health/ready routes.

F0003.statement: The /health/ready handler in main.py awaits dependency_status(settings), marks the response 503 HTTP_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE when any dependency is false, and returns ReadinessResponse with status ready or not_ready plus a per-dependency boolean map.

F0004.statement: main.py defines an inner async live() returning HealthResponse with the configured app_env, and this same function object is registered for both GET /health and GET /health/live.

F0005.statement: backend/migrations/env.py sets the SQLAlchemy URL from async_database_url(get_settings().database_url), wires target_metadata to Base.metadata, and dispatches to run_migrations_offline() or an asyncio run of run_migrations_online() based on context.is_offline_mode().

F0006.statement: The migration online path in env.py builds an async engine via async_engine_from_config with pool.NullPool, runs do_run_migrations through connection.run_sync, and then disposes the engine.

F0007.statement: env.py imports hybrid_rag_search.models for its side effect of registering models on Base.metadata so autogenerate sees them, and both migration paths configure compare_type=True; this is a metadata-import inference, not an observed runtime query.

F0008.statement: backend/pyproject.toml declares runtime dependencies including fastapi, uvicorn[standard], sqlalchemy[asyncio], asyncpg, alembic, redis, dramatiq[redis], cohere, httpx, pypdf, markdown-it-py, tokenizers, and pydantic-settings, requiring Python >=3.12,<3.14.

F0009.statement: pyproject pytest config uses --strict-config and --strict-markers with default deselect markers 'not integration and not live', a 100% coverage gate on hybrid_rag_search, and defines integration and live markers.

F0010.statement: The root Makefile wires development and operations targets: dev runs uvicorn with --reload alongside the frontend dev server; db-upgrade/db-downgrade/db-revision/db-current invoke alembic against backend/alembic.ini; db-seed runs python -m hybrid_rag_search.seed; and db-test promotes DB state then runs integration tests.

F0011.statement: Makefile targets tokenizer-setup, ingestion-recover, index-rebuild-start (requires BUILD_ID), and index-rebuild-promote (requires INDEX) invoke corresponding hybrid_rag_search modules; index-rebuild-start/promote pass the given BUILD_ID or INDEX as a positional argument.

F0012.statement: Makefile evaluation targets run the scifact module (download/validate/subset) and the evaluation runner with prepare and run subcommands, forwarding EVAL_DATASET, EVAL_OUTPUT, and delay parameters.

F0013.statement: Makefile stack-reset refuses to delete volumes unless CONFIRM=1 is provided, then runs docker compose down --volumes --remove-orphans; stack-up runs docker compose up --build --detach --wait.

F0014.statement: .github/workflows/ci.yml runs a Python matrix of 3.12/3.13 against postgres and opensearch service containers, then executes ruff format check, ruff check, mypy, pytest, alembic upgrade/check/downgrade/upgrade, two seed runs, and integration pytest.

F0015.statement: The frontend CI job (S0006) runs npm ci, format:check, lint, typecheck, test, and build in the frontend directory, and .pre-commit-config.yaml runs ruff check --fix, ruff format, and a frontend prettier --check over frontend source files.

F0016.statement: .github/workflows/repo-map.yml triggers on push and workflow_dispatch, requires the default branch, runs .repo-map/state.py prepare and publish plus .repo-map/incremental.py (with optional --full), and uploads map artifacts, using secrets for an LLM API key and publishing to a dedicated map branch.

F0017.statement: Migration 20260915_01 upgrade() defines a PostgreSQL trigger function set_updated_at() and attaches trg_<table>_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE triggers that set updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP on tenants, users, and memberships.

F0018.statement: Migration 20260915_01 creates the identity tables tenants, users, and memberships with CHECK constraints for non-blank names, slug format, normalized email, and allowed roles ('owner','admin','member'), plus FK constraints ontenant migrations to tenants.id and users.id with ondelete CASCADE.

F0019.statement: Migration 20260915_02 has down_revision '20260915_01', forming a linear revision chain after the identity migration.

F0020.statement: Migration 20260915_02 creates collections, collection_grants, documents, and ingestion_jobs; collection_grants enforces a permission enum ('read','write','manage') and composite FKs referencing collections(tenant_id,id) and memberships(tenant_id,id), with a unique constraint on (tenant_id, collection_id, membership_id).

F0021.statement: Migration 20260915_02 documents table enforces SHA-256 content_hash format, a status enum ('pending','processing','ready','failed','deleting','deleted'), and a CHECK that ties status='deleted' to non-null deleted_at; its FK to collections uses ondelete RESTRICT.

F0022.statement: Migration 20260915_02 ingestion_jobs tracks attempts, max_attempts (default 3), checkpoint JSONB, error_code/error_message, started_at/finished_at, and CHECKs that attempts <= max_attempts and status is in ('queued','running','succeeded','failed','cancelled').

F0023.statement: Migration 20260915_02 adds indexes ix_collection_grants_tenant_membership, ix_documents_content_hash, ix_documents_tenant_status, and ix_ingestion_jobs_tenant_status.

F0024.statement: Migration 20260915_02 attaches trg_<table>_updated_at triggers to the four content tables, reusing the set_updated_at() function created by migration 20260915_01 — a cross-migration dependency not declared via depends_on.

F0025.statement: Migration 20260915_03 defines a prevent_mutation() PL/pgSQL trigger that raises an 'is append-only' exception, and attaches it to retrieval_configs for BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE.

F0026.statement: Migration 20260915_03 creates retrieval_configs with a (tenant_id, name, version) unique constraint, parameters JSONB constrained to object type, and version > 0, making configs versioned/immutable per revision.

F0027.statement: Migration 20260915_03 creates query_traces with a content_captured boolean defaulting true and a CHECK that query_text may be NULL only when content_captured is false, plus SHA-256 normalized_query_hash check, selected_path, timing/ranking/usage/fallback JSONB fields, and FKs to collections and retrieval_configs both with ondelete RESTRICT.

F0028.statement: Migration 20260915_03's downgrade drops query_traces, drops the immutable trigger, drops retrieval_configs, and drops prevent_mutation(), so the append-only constraint is only enforced at the database layer.

F0029.statement: Migrations 20260915_01 and _02 both define a local _timestamps() helper producing created_at/updated_at columns with now() server defaults, applied consistently across the identity and content tables.

F0030.statement: No application code, HTTP routes, background workers, or user actions are present in this batch; the sources are schema definitions only, so runtime call wiring cannot be established from them.

F0031.statement: Documents carry storage_key, content_hash, source_metadata JSONB, and index_version, implying external object storage and indexing pipelines downstream, but this batch contains no code that reads or writes those values.

F0032.statement: query_traces records selected_path, timings, rankings, usage, and fallbacks, indicating a retrieval pipeline that records ranking/fallback decisions, but the actual retrieval execution code is not included here.

F0033.statement: Migration 20260915_04 upgrade() creates four tables: evaluation_datasets, judgments, evaluation_runs, and audit_events, with a composite FK from judgments to evaluation_datasets on (tenant_id, dataset_id) and RESTRICT FKs from evaluation_runs and audit_events.

F0034.statement: Upgrade of 20260915_04 installs BEFORE UPDATE OR DELETE triggers named trg_<table>_immutable on evaluation_datasets, judgments, and audit_events that call prevent_mutation(), making those tables append-only at the database level.

F0035.statement: Upgrade of 20260915_04 installs trigger trg_evaluation_runs_updated_at on evaluation_runs calling set_updated_at(), and downgrade() drops tables in reverse order: audit_events, evaluation_runs, judgments, evaluation_datasets.

F0036.statement: Migration 20260918_05 adds a non-null 'stage' column to ingestion_jobs defaulting to 'parse', backfills stage='complete' for rows with status='succeeded', and adds check constraints restricting stage to parse/chunk/embed/index/complete and tying status='succeeded' to stage='complete' in both directions.

F0037.statement: Migration 20260918_06 adds nullable content_hash and pipeline_version columns to ingestion_jobs, backfills content_hash from the related documents.content_hash, generates synthetic 'pipe_<hex>' pipeline_version values for legacy rows, then enforces NOT NULL plus regex check constraints and a unique constraint uq_ingestion_jobs_document_recipe on (tenant_id, document_id, content_hash, pipeline_version).

F0038.statement: Migration 20260918_07 adds nullable lease_token (UUID) and lease_expires_at columns to ingestion_jobs, resets status='running' rows back to 'queued', adds check constraint ck_ingestion_jobs_lease_matches_running requiring lease_token and lease_expires_at to be non-null exactly when status='running', and creates index ix_ingestion_jobs_status_lease on (status, lease_expires_at).

F0039.statement: Migration 20260918_08 adds nullable next_attempt_at to ingestion_jobs with check constraint ck_ingestion_jobs_retry_time_requires_queued ensuring next_attempt_at is NULL unless status='queued', plus index ix_ingestion_jobs_status_retry on (status, next_attempt_at).

F0040.statement: Settings in hybrid_rag_search/config.py defines typed runtime settings with defaults for database_url, redis_url, opensearch_url, OpenSearch alias/index names, BM25/dense/rerank candidate and result limits, storage/tokenizer/ingestion artifact roots, Cohere model/timeout/price settings, and a Cohere API key alias-resolved from COHERE_API_KEY or COHERE_TRIAL_KEY.

F0041.statement: Settings.validate_cross_field_settings is a pydantic model_validator(mode='after') that raises ValueError when embed-english-light-v3.0 is paired with non-384 dimensions, when rerank_result_limit exceeds rerank_candidate_limit, or when the Cohere rerank timeout exceeds retrieval_deadline_seconds.

F0042.statement: get_settings() is an lru_cache-decorated factory returning a new Settings() instance, so settings are constructed once per process; Settings uses SettingsConfigDict(env_file='.env', extra='ignore') so unknown environment variables are ignored rather than rejected.

F0043.statement: The alembic revision chain in these files is linear: 20260915_04 revises 20260915_03; 20260918_05 revises 20260915_04; 20260918_06 revises 20260918_05; 20260918_07 revises 20260918_06; 20260918_08 revises 20260918_07.

F0044.statement: hybrid_rag_search/__init__.py contains only a package docstring ('Hybrid RAG Search API package.') with no imports or executable code, so it declares no runtime entry point or exported symbol.

F0045.statement: Several evaluation and audit columns carry JSONB server defaults ('{}'::jsonb or '[]'::jsonb) and matching jsonb_typeof check constraints (object vs array) in migration 20260915_04.

F0046.statement: Migration 20260915_04 enforces evaluation dataset constraints including SHA-256 regex on corpus_hash, non-blank name, positive version, and uniqueness of (tenant_id, id) and (tenant_id, name, version), with CAST/ondelete CASCADE from tenants to evaluation_datasets.

F0047.statement: Judgments constrain target_type to ('document','chunk'), relevance_grade to [0,3], require non-blank query_key/query_text/target_id, and enforce uniqueness of (tenant_id, dataset_id, query_key, target_type, target_id); audit_events validate namespaced action formats, entity_type format, non-blank entity_id, and RESTRICT FKs to tenants and memberships.

F0048.statement: The migrations reference helper SQL functions prevent_mutation() and set_updated_at() without defining them in these files, so those functions must be provided by an earlier migration; the connection is inferred from function invocation, not an in-file definition.

F0049.statement: database.py defines a shared declarative Base whose metadata applies a naming convention for indexes, unique constraints, check constraints, foreign keys and primary keys; content models import this Base.

F0050.statement: async_database_url rewrites a plain 'postgresql' driver name to 'postgresql+asyncpg' and leaves other driver names unchanged.

F0051.statement: DocumentService.upload computes a SHA-256 digest of the uploaded bytes and, inside a single session transaction, locks the collection row with with_for_update() before checking for an existing non-deleting/non-deleted Document with the same tenant, collection and content_hash; a match returns UploadResult with duplicate=True and no new file write.

F0052.statement: On a non-duplicate upload, DocumentService.upload inserts a Document with status PENDING and a storage key derived via storage_key(tenant_id, document_id), flushes the session, then performs the filesystem save via asyncio.to_thread so file I/O runs off the event loop.

F0053.statement: DocumentService._document loads a Document with a row lock scoped by tenant_id and id, raises DocumentNotFound when absent, and raises ValueError if document.storage_key does not equal storage_key(tenant_id, document_id) as a cross-tenant/corruption guard.

F0054.statement: DocumentService.fetch raises DocumentUnavailable if the document status is DELETING or DELETED, otherwise reads the bytes through storage.fetch executed with asyncio.to_thread.

F0055.statement: DocumentService.delete uses two separate transactions: the first commits status DELETING as durable intent, the second performs storage.delete (off-loop) then sets status DELETED, deleted_at and clears error_message; an already-DELETED document returns early.

F0056.statement: health.check_postgres opens an asyncpg connection using settings.database_url with a 2-second timeout, issues 'SELECT 1', and always closes the connection in a finally block.

F0057.statement: health.check_redis pings Redis built from settings.redis_url and raises ConnectionError when PING is falsy, closing the client in a finally block via aclose().

F0058.statement: health.check_opensearch performs an HTTP GET to {settings.opensearch_url}/_cluster/health with a 2-second timeout and calls response.raise_for_status().

F0059.statement: dependency_status concurrently runs the postgres, redis and opensearch checks via asyncio.gather wrapped in run_check, which converts any exception into False, and returns a dict keyed by 'postgres', 'redis', 'opensearch'.

F0060.statement: models/__init__.py re-exports content, evaluation, identity and retrieval model classes and status/stage enums as the package's public model surface.

F0061.statement: Collection defines tenant-scoped unique constraints on (tenant_id, id) and (tenant_id, slug) plus check constraints enforcing a non-blank name and a lowercase hyphenated slug format.

F0062.statement: Document enforces a composite foreign key (tenant_id, collection_id) to collections with ondelete RESTRICT, a unique (tenant_id, collection_id, source_key), a SHA-256-format check on content_hash, and a check tying status='deleted' to deleted_at IS NOT NULL.

F0063.statement: IngestionJob references documents via composite (tenant_id, document_id) FK with ondelete CASCADE and enforces consistency between status and stage (succeeded iff complete) and between running status and non-null lease_token/lease_expires_at, plus retry/time constraints and status/lease/retry indexes.

F0064.statement: Document and IngestionJob carry content-hash and pipeline-version fields with check constraints requiring content_hash to match a 64-hex-char SHA-256 pattern and pipeline_version to match '^pipe_[0-9a-f]{64}$', indicating ingestion recipes are keyed by content hash and a derived pipeline version.
